description: Text-to-speech via SaluteSpeech. Accepts text, returns Base64-encoded audio.

format.description: Audio container/codec: opus, wav16, pcm16, alaw (sample rate comes from the voice suffix)

text.description: Text to synthesize (max 4000 chars incl. spaces/markup)

voice.description: Voice id <speaker>_<rate>. Speakers: Nec (Наталья), Bys (Борис), May (Марфа), Tur (Тарас), Ost (Александра), Pon (Сергей), Kin (Kira, English). Rate suffix 24000 or 8000 (telephony) sets the sample rate. Other languages are selected via SSML lang, not the voice id.

name: synthesize_speech
